Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara's Brand & Creative team is a tight-knit collective spanning brand, communication, digital, film/video, motion graphics, and photography. We operate as an internal agency, and we move fast.
We're looking for a cinematographer/DP + video editor who owns a story from pre- to post-production. You'll be behind the camera and in the timeline: documentary customer stories shot on job sites and out in the field with operators, product films that make complex technology clear, and brand work with real emotional weight.
We're a small and mighty team, so this is a hands-on role. You'll shoot and cut most of the work yourself, with freelance support on the productions that need it.
This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco. We're open to candidates within 90 minutes of our SF headquarters.

You want to impact the industries that run our world. Your work will tell the stories of the people who keep the world's operations moving.
You're the architect of your own career. You'll have the autonomy to lead major initiatives and define the future of video at Samsara.
You're energized by our opportunity. You'll use film to make complex technology clear for a global audience.
You want to be with the best. You'll work alongside a team of top-tier creatives: filmmakers, designers, and storytellers.

Shoot and edit world-class films across marketing, sales, product, customer, recruiting, and corporate communications
Lead productions end to end, and solve ambiguous problems that carry real weight across multiple teams
Shape narrative, pacing, and visual direction from the earliest stage of a brief, not just at execution
Manage color, sound mix, finishing, and delivery across formats and channels, including social and vertical cutdowns
Influence the broader direction of Samsara's visual media and contribute to our creative strategy
Dig into what's slowing our productions down, find the root cause, and define how we fix it
Bring multiple teams into alignment on complex video initiatives, building consensus across organizational lines
Pitch new visual concepts that push our creative work forward
Build realistic timelines and communicate clearly through review cycles and final delivery
Source and manage freelance support as needed
Partner with Motion Design so live action and motion feel like one brand
Own media management across productions: backups, archive, and shared storage
Own equipment inventory and make the case for what we need next, in line with budget
Be a steward of the Samsara brand on every production

Greenlight is looking for a Video Editor, Paid Social to help bring our creative strategy to life on screen. You'll take briefs, raw footage, and creator content and turn them into fast, scroll-stopping videos built specifically for paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc).

This is a great role for someone early in their editing career who already has strong instincts for pacing, hooks, and platform-native storytelling, and wants to sharpen those instincts against real performance data. This is a hands-on, production-focused role with room to grow.
